label: AMS demo boundary
query: Why is the Kyriba Source event safe to demo as full-spine while the AMS event is not?
answer: My read For Lakeshore Holdings, the Kyriba treasury program is demo-safe as a “full Source spine” because its artifacts from Strategy through BAFO are actually present, stage-tagged, and approved; the AMS modernization program only has credible content through Evaluation, so treating it as if Decision/Transition/Value are real would cross the line from demo into fiction. Why 1) Artifact depth and integrity LSH-KYRIBA-TREASURY-2026 has a document-real Source spine: Strategy, Optioning, RFP, Evaluation, and BAFO are all populated and marked approved. That means every downstream screen the product shows (e.g., how decisions trace back to strategy, how BAFO ties to requirements) is backed by real, consistent artifacts. LSH-AMS-MODERNIZATION-2026 is explicitly “safe only through Evaluation.” The later stages — Executive Decision, Selection, Transition, Value — are still in review/needs-review and do not have the same stage-backed, internally consistent artifacts. 2) Truthfulness and auditability For Kyriba, what the Source module displays matches the underlying CSV/context-loader data and its status flags. If someone drills in during a demo, the decision trail is auditable back to Strategy and BAFO without making anything up. For AMS, presenting a “full lifecycle” would imply decisions and value-realization evidence that your own ledger does not yet support. That breaks the product principle that demos must stay within the loaded tenant truth — especially important while Lakeshore’s setup/admin approval-ledger is still incomplete.Evidence checked: intake.tenant_context (loaded tenant context), source_events.current_stage (sourcing stage and gate state), intake.question_scope (question scope), telemetry.answer_trace (answer trace).
